THE EXIT | G5-G6 | Reckoning, 2023
Decision, transaction and strategic framing
|
+-- Sequence, not proof of why management changed its mind
|   [S] Q4 2022 call: continue integrating SFN in 2023.
|   [S] Q1 2023 call: sell majority to Flexport; retain SFN app.
|   [R] Majority sale completed June 6, 2023.
|   Integration plan -[C:data]-> sale announcement.
|
+-- What Shopify received and recognized
|   [R] Transaction equity interest: 13% in Flexport.
|   [S] With prior holding: high teens; right to name a director.
|   [R] Non-cash consideration: $528M, estimated with unobservable inputs.
|   [R] Net impairment on logistics sales: $1,340M.
|   [S] Sale-related accelerated stock compensation: $165M.
|   [I] These accounting amounts are not a complete cash-loss ledger.
|
+-- Interpretation shifted
|   [S] 2022: logistics would energize the merchant flywheel.
|   [S] 2023: infrastructure called a side effort; focus on software.
|   [I] Failed integration bet is an interpretation of the exit.
|   [I] Supplied excerpts do not show management calling it a mistake.
|
`-- Disclosure boundary
    [I] No buyer or sale price for 6 River Systems is supplied here.
    [I] No full acquisition-to-exit cash-return reconciliation supplied.
Evidence: X1-X4.
